dramatic_structure.goal: separate receipt of a verified sound cue from later source confirmation

locked_facts.value: A project-original timer emits two verified pulses before its source is visible.
The caretaker follows the repeated pulse toward a closed wall panel.
Opening the panel reveals the timer beside a normal ventilation-cycle indicator.
